retrieval_policy.this_job: No network resource, linked page, video, chat, stream, repository, restricted content, or authenticated content was fetched.
retrieval_policy.kickoff_dependency_rule: The kickoff must remain usable from the bundled learner-safe documents and a local Linux/Python environment; unverified links are optional discovery inputs only.
later_job_allowed: Retrieve only publicly accessible resources that are within the later job's authorization.
Record the exact URL, retrieval time, revision or content digest, license or access terms, and availability result.
Classify each retrieved item before adding graph nodes or learner dependencies.
Use independently controlled validators for any completion claim.
later_job_forbidden: Do not bypass authentication, access controls, paywalls, invitations, or platform restrictions.
Do not scrape Discord, private chats, learner submissions, hidden graders, sealed references, or restricted challenge answers.
Do not infer an official module solely from a normalized link record, channel title, aggregate assignment count, or catalog prose.
Do not silently substitute invented material for an unavailable official resource.
retrieval_policy.failure_handling: Keep unavailable or failed retrieval records explicit. A failed or disallowed retrieval remains blocked and cannot be treated as learner-visible material.
